lines.zh: 我在村里来回走，走得很慢
lines.en: I walk back and forth through the village, slowly.

lines.zh: 我不知道该去哪，就一直走
lines.en: I do not know where to go, so I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我绕着一棵树的跟转圈
lines.en: I circle the base of a tree.

lines.zh: 我走过自家的门口又走回来
lines.en: I pass my own door and come back.
Head down, I watch the dirt.

lines.zh: 我走一段就停下，想一想
lines.en: I walk a stretch, stop, and think.

lines.zh: 我踩到自己的影子，回头看
lines.en: I step on my shadow and look back.
Others are working; I am walking.
I feel my way along the fence.

lines.zh: 我走得很随意，方向常常变
lines.en: I walk aimlessly, often changing direction.
I pass the workbench without stopping.
I head toward wherever the butterflies are.
I stand with my hands at my sides.

lines.zh: 我看着一只蝴蝶落在栅栏上
lines.en: I watch a butterfly settle on the fence.

lines.zh: 我不太懂别人在忙什么
lines.en: I do not quite follow what others are doing.

lines.zh: 我的口袋里有一颗种子
lines.en: There is a seed in my pocket.
I look up at the sky for a long while.
I scratch the back of my neck.

lines.zh: 我数不清今天过了多久
lines.en: I cannot tell how long today has been.
I do not recognize these goods.
I sigh, faintly.

lines.zh: 蝴蝶的颜色我倒是记得
lines.en: The colors of the butterflies, those I remember.
I sit down slowly.
I do not know what to sell.
I nod at whoever passes.

lines.zh: 我抬头，愣了一下才反应过来
lines.en: I look up, and take a moment to react.

lines.zh: 你要买东西吗，我这儿没货
lines.en: Are you buying? I have nothing in stock.
I scratch my head and smile.

lines.zh: 你是新来的吧，我见过所有人
lines.en: You are new, right? I have seen everyone here.

lines.zh: 我叫不出你的名字，抱歉
lines.en: I cannot recall your name; sorry.
I point at the trees over there.
There are butterflies over there; many.

lines.zh: 你站得这么近，我有点慌
lines.en: You are standing very close; I am a bit nervous.

lines.zh: 我在围裙上擦了擦手才看你。
lines.en: I wipe my hands on my apron before meeting your eyes.
The person you want is not me.
I tuck my hands into my sleeves.

lines.zh: 这村子的事我知道一半
lines.en: I know half of what goes on here.
Have you come for the butterflies?

lines.zh: 我不懂那些，但我能指路
lines.en: I do not understand those things, but I can point the way.
Do not laugh at me.
I open my mouth, then close it.
Were you going to ask me something?
I sat down and cannot get up.
I curl around my stomach.
I cry out, and it sounds bad.
I back against the wall.

lines.zh: 我不知道你为什么打我
lines.en: I do not know why you hit me.
Blood runs from my brow into my eye.
I raise an arm; it does not help.
My cap fell off.
I gasp and cannot speak.
I do not blame you, truly.

lines.zh: 你手里的面包，我闻见麦香了。
lines.en: I can smell the wheat in the bread you hold.
I look at it, and do not dare take it.
I have no money; I cannot trade.
I take it, my hands a little shaky.
Can this be traded?

lines.zh: 我藏进袖子，怕被人看见
lines.en: I hide it in my sleeve, afraid of being seen.
I ate earlier; not very hungry.
You are kind; thank you.
How should I thank you?
I do not recognize this.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我差点坐地上
lines.en: We collide; I nearly sit down.
I back two steps and apologize at once.

lines.zh: 我手上什么也没有，别怕
lines.en: I am holding nothing; do not worry.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我撞晕了一下
lines.en: That left me dazed for a moment.
I hold the wall to steady myself.
I was not watching where I went.
You are sturdier than me.
My cap is crooked; I straighten it.
Dust kicks up from the ground.
I did not mean to block your way.
That, well, I do not really understand.
I am used to being on my own.

lines.zh: 你要是留下，我可以带你看蝴蝶
lines.en: If you stay, I could show you the butterflies.
I would sweep the doorway clean.
I am not skilled, but I am not lazy.
Walk with me; I know the way.
I have saved a little; not much.
You would not mind that I am slow, would you?

lines.zh: 我愿意把最好的留给你
lines.en: I would keep the best for you.
That is all I can say; I am no speaker.
Whose did I drop?

lines.zh: 我拿着它，不知道该怎么用
lines.en: I hold it and do not know what to do with it.
I put it in my pocket.
This is rather heavy.
I picked three up; all stones.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，不知道该怎么用。
lines.en: I hold it and have no idea what to do with it.
I cannot bend that far.
I will take it and ask someone.
Someone is coming over there.
I stand still first.
I am not sure whether to go over.

lines.zh: 你手里没拿东西，那我放心
lines.en: You are empty-handed; that puts me at ease.
I edge to one side.

lines.zh: 我认得这个村子的每一条路
lines.en: I know every path in this village.

lines.zh: 我看看你是不是认识的人
lines.en: Let me see whether you are someone I know.
I am not good with strangers.
I wait for you to speak first.
You are heading toward the butterflies.
Should I stop this, or let it be?
I step behind the door first.
I have not seen this before.
I think it over, and walk over.

lines.zh: 我只是个笨蛋，别为难我
lines.en: I am just a fool; do not make it hard for me.
I watch from a distance, afraid to approach.
I do not understand what you are doing.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走了几步，又停下
lines.en: I follow a few steps, then stop.

lines.zh: 你要是问路，我可以带你
lines.en: If you need the way, I can guide you.
I try not to be in your way.
I look up at the butterflies in the trees.
I do not know what to say.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往后退，退到墙边
lines.en: I slowly back to the wall.
Do you find me annoying?
I ruffle my hair.

lines.zh: 我想帮忙，但不知道从哪帮
lines.en: I want to help, but do not know how.
I do not quite dare to look at you.
I look down at my shoes.
I cannot keep up.
I stop and wait for you to look back.
I only wanted to see where you were going.

lines.zh: 我举起扫帚，却只是乱挥。
lines.en: I raise my broom and only flail it.
I back up and hit the fence.
I do not hit people; I never have.

lines.zh: 我拿了个木棍，其实不会用
lines.en: I picked up a stick, but I cannot use it.
I swing once and miss.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己也吓了一跳
lines.en: That startled me as much as you.
I shout, and my voice is small.

lines.zh: 我只是想让你别再靠近
lines.en: I only wanted you to stop coming closer.
My hands are shaking.
Hit me if you must.
I cover my face.
I drop to the ground.

lines.zh: 这棍子是我扫院子用的
lines.en: This stick is for sweeping the yard.
I do not want trouble.
People are watching, and I panic more.
I throw the stick away.

lines.zh: 我在这村子里待了很久
lines.en: I have been in this village a long while.
Everyone else has work; I do not.

lines.zh: 我站在路口，不知道往哪走
lines.en: I stand at the crossroads, unsure which way.
Someone put me here.

lines.zh: 我听见蝴蝶翅膀的声音
lines.en: I hear butterfly wings.
I know these roofs well.

lines.zh: 我数了数，村里有七户人家
lines.en: I counted: seven households here.
I step out of the house.

lines.zh: 这地方的东西我大多不认得
lines.en: I do not recognize most things here.
I have stood at the door since morning.

lines.zh: 风里有草和花粉的味道
lines.en: The wind smells of grass and pollen.

lines.zh: 我不知道今天该做什么
lines.en: I do not know what to do today.
Someone passes; I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我把门口的石子踢到一边
lines.en: I kick a pebble from the doorway.
This village is busier than I expected.
I just woke up and have not worked it out.
I look toward those trees.
Another ordinary day.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的袖子，我乱拍
lines.en: Fire catches my sleeve; I slap at it wildly.

lines.zh: 我从梯子上摔下来，摔得很实
lines.en: I fall from the ladder, hard.
Water fills my mouth; I claw at nothing.
The blast throws me into the vegetable patch.
An arrow sticks in my leg.

lines.zh: 一股凉意穿过我，我打了个寒颤
lines.en: A chill passes through me and I shiver.

lines.zh: 我忘了吃饭，肚子一直叫
lines.en: I forgot to eat, and my stomach keeps growling.

lines.zh: 雷声太响，我捂住耳朵蹲下
lines.en: The thunder is too loud; I cover my ears and crouch.
